Register Now About Ho Ho 5K The Ho Ho 5K is a holiday 5K run and walk hosted by X-Dog Adventures at Cook Park, 17005 SW 92nd Ave, Portland, OR. Holiday costumes are encouraged, and friendly dogs are welcome. Every finisher gets Hostess HoHos and Sno Balls, and there are free trees and, yes, the fruitcake. Bring warm clothes to change into for the post-race festivities. The race also collects canned food, jackets and blankets, and cat and dog food for the humane society, so bring a donation if you can. Late registration and bib pickup open at 8 AM on race morning.
